name: Aroha Bennett
bio:
Aroha Bennett's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental, starting with a temporary admin role at a local racing circuit. Quickly, she found herself drawn to the fast-paced environment and the passionate individuals within it. Her knack for understanding people and fostering positive relationships led her to HR, where she now thrives. 

Aroha believes in building strong teams by identifying and nurturing talent, creating a supportive atmosphere where everyone can contribute their best. She emphasizes open communication and inclusivity, striving to ensure every team member feels valued and heard. Her approach is deeply rooted in Maori principles of Whanaungatanga (relationship, kinship, sense of connection) and Manaakitanga (hospitality, kindness, generosity, support). Aroha is known for her intuitive understanding of team dynamics and her ability to resolve conflicts with empathy and fairness.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aroha has a warm, friendly face framed by strong cheekbones and a kind smile.

quirks: Always has a small pounamu (greenstone) pendant that she rubs when thinking deeply.
Keeps a jar of homemade Anzac biscuits in her office for visitors.
Starts every meeting with a brief 'check-in' round, asking everyone to share one thing they are grateful for.
